title: Kilo canvas
author: intuitiv

test_results.reason: PR scope too large and security issues too severe to warrant testing. Would require 2-3 hours to set up React Native environment, build mobile app, and verify HTTP bridge. Security vulnerability (0.0.0.0 binding with no auth) makes local testing inadvisable.

blocking_issues: CRITICAL: HTTP server binds to 0.0.0.0 with no authentication - remote code execution vulnerability
CRITICAL: PR scope unmanageable at 25,386 lines across 112 files - should be 8-10 separate PRs
CRITICAL: Breaking change (.kilocodemodes JSON to YAML) with no migration code
CRITICAL: Binary artifacts committed (app-release.apk, font files)
HIGH: Zero test coverage for 486-line MobileBridge.ts
HIGH: Mobile app uses JavaScript instead of TypeScript
lessons: PRs over 10K lines are effectively unreviewable - enforce size limits
Network binding to 0.0.0.0 should trigger mandatory security review
Breaking config format changes must include migration code
Binary artifacts (APKs, fonts) should never be committed to git
Large PRs hide breaking changes - .kilocodemodes change buried in 25K lines
Mobile app testing requires video demos and test evidence logs
Documentation duplication (2 MOBILE_BRIDGE_API.md files) indicates drift
When title doesn't match content ('canvas' vs 'mobile app'), scope creep occurred
Compiled artifacts show author may not understand build/release process
Strong engineering skills (React Native architecture) can still produce unmerge-able PRs if delivery approach is wrong
